fields.help_en:
The input media.

If Type is set to OSS, specify an OSS URL.

If Type is set to Media, specify a media asset ID.

OSS URL format:

oss://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object

In the URL, bucket is the name of the OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path.

Before you use the OSS bucket in the URL, add it to IMS https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html
fields.help_zh:
输入媒体。

当Type为OSS时填入OSS地址。

Type为Media时填入媒资ID。

OSS地址规则为：

oss://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS bucket名称，object为文件路径。

URL中的 OSS bucket 需要先添加到IMShttps://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html后再使用

fields.help_en: The height of the output animated image. Valid values: 128 to 4096
fields.help_zh: 输出动图高度。取值范围：[128, 4096]
fields.name: height

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-rotation (long-short side mode). Valid values:

true: Enables auto-rotation.
false: Disables auto-rotation.

Default value: true.
The width of the transcoding output corresponds to the long side of the input source (the height for portrait videos), and the height corresponds to the short side of the input source (the width for portrait videos)
fields.help_zh:
是否开启横竖屏自适应（长短边模式）。取值：

true：开启横竖屏自适应。
false：关闭横竖屏自适应。

默认值：true。
转码输出的宽对应输入片源的长边（竖屏为片源的高），高对应输入视频的短边（竖屏为片源的宽）
fields.name: long_short_mode

fields.help_en:
The scan mode. Valid values:

interlaced: interlaced scan.

progressive: progressive scan. This is the default value
fields.help_zh:
扫描模式。可取值：

interlaced：交叉扫描。

progressive：顺序扫描。默认值
fields.name: scan_mode

fields.help_en:
The duration.
Format: `hh:mm:ss[.SSS]` or `sssss[.SSS]`.
Valid values: `[00:00:00.000,23:59:59.999]` or `[0.000,86399.999]`
fields.name: duration

fields.help_en:
The tail trimming duration, which specifies the length of time to trim from the end. When this parameter is set, the Duration parameter becomes invalid.
Format: `hh:mm:ss[.SSS]` or `sssss[.SSS]`.
Valid values: `[00:00:00.000,23:59:59.999]` or `[0.000,86399.999]`
fields.help_zh:
截尾时长，表示切掉尾部的若干时长。设置此值时，参数Duration失效。
格式：`hh:mm:ss[.SSS]`或`sssss[.SSS]`。
取值范围 ：`[00:00:00.000,23:59:59.999]`或`[0.000，86399.999]`
fields.name: end

fields.help_en:
The start time.  

Format: `hh:mm:ss[.SSS]` or `sssss[.SSS]`.
Valid values: `[00:00:00.000,23:59:59.999]` or `[0.000,86399.999]`
fields.name: seek

fields.help_en: The width of the output animated image. Valid values: 128 to 4096
fields.help_zh: 输出动图宽度。取值范围：[128, 4096]
fields.name: width

fields.help_en: The priority. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 6. A larger value indicates a higher priority
fields.help_zh: 优先级，1-10，默认6。数值越大，优先级越高
fields.name: priority
